market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a triple threat: oil above $100 from Iran conflict, rate volatility from Bessent's failed intervention, and trade war escalation with Canada. Expect elevated VIX, sector rotation into energy/defense/gold, and pressure on consumer discretionary and rate-sensitive equities. Oracle earnings will be the key AI sentiment catalyst. US stocks eked out gains but face headwinds from PPI data and tech earnings.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and rate pressure eases, creating a re-rating opportunity for growth equities. AI capex ROI validation through 2026-2027 earnings will determine whether the AI trade matures or corrects. China's inflation rebound and policy divergence offer structural EM opportunities. Trade war with Canada, if prolonged, reshapes North American supply chains. Gold's $4,400 level suggests structural de-dollarization and geopolitical risk premium is here to stay.
